environment.description: Same Tomcat application deployed behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with a fixed-response action on the default listener that injects response headers. The ALB listener rule uses a 'modify-response-header' action (available via ALB response header insertion feature, GA 2023) that appends a Content-Security-Policy header with value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'" to ALL responses passing through the ALB. Note: this is applied at the ALB layer, not in application code - the servlet has no CSP logic. Additionally, the SQS queue has a dead-letter queue redrive policy with maxReceiveCount=3, and CloudWatch alarms on ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible. The Tomcat connector has server.xml configured with maxThreads=200 and connectionTimeout=20000.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with response header insertion
config.sqs_producers: public form submission service, internal microservices
